data_description.scan_interval: How often the controller is asked for its clients, in seconds (30–300). Increase it on large setups to reduce the load on the controller.
data_description.details_interval: How often each connected client's IP and SSID are read from the controller's client detail page, in minutes (1–15). Each refresh costs one request per client. Only used on controllers that have the classic detail page (a full WLC).
data_description.stale_tracker_age: Disabled trackers of clients not seen for this many days are deleted (1–60). They are recreated, disabled, when the client connects again.
